record.reason: BayesER is a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that orders token commitment in masked diffusion language models by predictive entropy; decoding-time, but aimed at calibration of generation rather than inference efficiency or serving.
record.title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
